$description: EmptyState (platform/components/EmptyState): the tokens of its warning and success tones (library wave 4); its other tokens are in components.tokens.json.

empty-state-warning-icon-text.$description: EmptyState: the icon of the warning tone (offline, degraded), in the warning solid on the surface; the title says what needs care, so color is never the only sign.

empty-state-success-icon-text.$description: EmptyState: the icon of the success tone (completion), in the success solid on the surface; the title says what is done.
